entities.name: Kela Chensal
entities.description: A Jeskai Arbiter Twin born in the light of dawn, who declares innocence.

entities.name: Dar Chensal
entities.description: A Jeskai Arbiter Twin born in the darkness of night, who announces guilt.

entities.name: Jeskai Clan
entities.description: The clan of Tarkir whose society relies on the Arbiter Twins.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane where the twins live.

entities.name: Jigme Village
entities.description: A village where the twins adjudicate a case of stolen apples.

entities.name: Elder Ngabo
entities.description: The elder of Jigme Village, who dies after eating apple soup.

entities.name: Lotse Taring
entities.description: A man accused of stealing apples and later of murdering the elder.

entities.name: Combat of Clarity
entities.description: An old tradition in which disagreeing Arbiter Twins fight in single combat.

events.summary: Kela and Dar are called to Jigme Village to judge the theft of nine baskets of apples; Elder Ngabo brings them before Lotse Taring.
events.quote: Kela and Dar were called to Jigme Village to adjudicate a case of nine baskets of apples that had been stolen.

events.summary: Dar lights the lamp of guilt, ending the trial and convicting Lotse of theft.
events.quote: revealing that Dar had lit the lamp of guilt, ending the trial.

events.summary: Elder Ngabo chokes and dies after tasting the apple soup, and villagers accuse Lotse of poisoning.
events.quote: She commented that the soup was delicious, then suddenly choked and died.

events.summary: Kela demands a fair trial for Lotse, and in the new trial both twins light their lamps, disagreeing.
events.quote: but this time both Kela and Dar lit their lamps at the same time.

events.summary: Kela defeats Dar in the Combat of Clarity, proclaiming Lotse innocent of the murder.
events.quote: Defeated, Dar conceded, and Kela let him up, thus proclaiming that Lotse was innocent of the murder of Elder Ngabo.

relations.quote: They share a magical bond where they enter a meditative state
Kela and Dar Chensal are a pair of Arbiter Twins of the Jeskai Clan in Tarkir 's original timeline.
